S1.message: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
S1.answer:
**Get Clássica** is aimed at faster payments and receipts. It has a 3G chip, Wi-Fi and a printer roll, and rental is free at R$10,000/month in sales. Otherwise it costs R$79.90/month. (https://www.santander.com.br/blog/seus-negocios/solucoes-getnet/)

**Get Smart** goes further, with order-to-payment integration for management. It has a 3G chip with a free data plan plus Wi-Fi, and rental is free at R$60,000/month in sales. Otherwise it costs R$129.90/month. (https://www.santander.com.br/blog/seus-negocios/solucoes-getnet/)

Both accept tap and Pix via QR Code. Get Smart also runs Android and can integrate with APIs. (https://www.getnet.net/en/our-solutions/in-person-payments)

Fees and thresholds: https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/termos_e_condicoes_aluguel.pdf

S4.message: Do I need a bank account to receive my sales via Pix?
S4.answer:
Yes. To sell with Pix on Get Tap, you must enable the feature and link a bank account in the Getnet Brasil app. The path is Services → "Venda com Pix" → "Habilitar", then choose your bank and follow the on-screen instructions. The linked account is the one that receives the Pix payments.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix-no-get-tap-mais-agilidade-e-eficiencia-das-vendas/

S5.message: My card machine won't connect to the internet, what should I do?
S5.answer:
Your terminal (GS-77A1) is offline. It was last seen today at 08:17 (UTC-3). Its Wi-Fi signal is weak, battery is 42%, and firmware is 4.2.1 (4.3.0 is available).

**Get Smart:** tap "Configurar" on the home screen, then:
- **Wi-Fi:** view the available networks and connect to one.
- **Conexões:** manage Wi-Fi, the 4G chip and Bluetooth, check data usage, and run a "Teste de Conexão". Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Manul-GetSmart.pdf

**Get Clássica:** tap Wi-Fi or Suporte, select Habilitar Wi-Fi, then Procurar Redes. Choose your network and enter the password if needed. The machine also has a free 3G chip. Source: https://sitehml.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/Manul_GetClassica.pdf

The weak Wi-Fi signal is the main issue in the data. If you'd like, I can open a ticket so our team can look into the connection problem. Just tell me the priority you want.

S6.message: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
S6.answer:
Receivables advance lets you receive credit card sales (lump-sum or installments) before the originally scheduled date, in exchange for a fee. It is not a loan: you get money that is already yours, with no new debt. Eligible sales depend on your contracted solution. (https://site.getnet.com.br/quando-vale-a-pena-antecipar-as-suas-vendas-no-cartao/)

In the Getnet Brasil app, you can check available receivables, simulate the advance, and see the net amount before confirming. (https://site.getnet.com.br/quando-vale-a-pena-antecipar-as-suas-vendas-no-cartao/)

On the Get Smart terminal: Payment > Advance (Antecipação) > enter merchant password > select card brand > query and simulate > tap "Antecipar" > enter the advance code from the query > the terminal confirms and prints a receipt. (https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Manul-GetSmart.pdf)

S9.message: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?
S9.answer:
With Crediário Getnet you can split a sale into up to 48 installments. The exact maximum depends on the customer's issuing bank (e.g., some banks up to 24x, Santander up to 48x), and the customer needs enough available credit limit for the full purchase amount.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Folder_Credirio.pdf

S10.message: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?
S10.answer:
Yes. Getnet's Payment Link lets you send a link to customers via WhatsApp, social networks, email, or any other digital channel, with no card machine or online store needed. Customers pay by credit card, debit card, or Pix.
